About HUP

A place to stay. People to turn to. Practical support for the next step.

WHERE POTENTIAL MEETS OPPORTUNITIES

Help with the next step

Losing a place to live can come with other difficulties: finding work, managing personal problems or knowing where to ask for help.

HUP brings temporary accommodation and daily meals for clients together with counselling, guidance on finding employment and referrals to specialist services. Its shelter is listed for men; please speak to the team about who can stay and the support available.

Our founder’s approach

Founder Buang Mfumane has spoken about looking at what each person can do and helping them find opportunities to support themselves.

That means thinking beyond a bed for the night. It can mean help with looking for work, using existing skills or connecting with the right service for a particular need.

Read Buang’s October 2022 interview ↗
